meta.name: anomaly-driven-abduction
meta.description: Tactic: Inductive/abductive path — describe anomalous phenomena, generate candidate explanations, rank by plausibility

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析异常现象并生成合理解释
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要从异常现象推导可能原因
copy.tagline_en: Analyze anomalies and generate plausible explanations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to infer causes from unusual observations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会先要求你精确描述异常现象，然后自动生成至少3个候选解释，最后按合理性排序，并给出排序依据。全程不容许模糊或主观偏好。
howto.when: 当你描述一个现有理论无法解释的异常现象，并要求进行溯因分析时触发。

say.text: 这个观测数据与理论预测不符，请帮我做溯因推理。
say.note: Claude 会执行三步分析，输出解释及排序。

say.text: 我们实验中发现了一个异常，可能是新物理，请分析。
say.note: Claude 会生成多候选解释，并评估可信度。

howto.what_en: Claude will first ask for a precise description of an anomaly, then automatically generate at least 3 candidate explanations, rank them by plausibility, and provide justification. No vagueness or subjective preference allowed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you describe an anomalous phenomenon unexplained by existing theory and request abductive analysis.

say_en.text: This observation deviates from theory; please perform abductive reasoning.
say_en.note: Claude runs the three steps and outputs ranked explanations.

say_en.text: We encountered an anomaly in our experiment, possibly new physics. Analyze it.
say_en.note: Claude generates multiple hypotheses and evaluates plausibility.
